messages:
Maddie H.: AuburnAI flagged ~6h of missing audit delivery to their S3 bucket. SOC is asking for a playback before renewal next week. Any immediate triage?
Priya K.: Joined their call. Delivery counts dropped ~40% at 03:00Z. Manifest lists ~14 suspect objects. SSE-KMS header missing on those PUTs.
Kyra L.: Checking our forwarder agent health and IAM. Will post findings.
Josh R.: Quick check: forwarder role might lack kms:Decrypt after a key rollover. I'll look at CloudTrail errors.
eng-deploy-bot: auburn-vpc-agent-2 heartbeat @ 2026-03-20T17:58:45Z  status: healthy
Kyra L.: Confirmed: role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rdw-logs-forwarder-auburn missing kms:Decrypt. Opening INFRA-4821.
Samir V.: Marking renewal_risk=medium. Security wants a signed proof bundle for 30 days (S3 manifests + KMS metadata + CloudTrail). If gaps, document and propose remediation.
Maddie H.: Tell Auburn we have a remediation plan and ETA.
Priya K.: They use SSE-KMS server-side per call. So forwarder is the likely cause.
Josh R.: IAM snippet to add to forwarder policy:
{ "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345" }
Kyra L.: PR created: adds policy change + restart job. ETA ~2h. CI passing.
Samir V.: After deploy: verify S3 headers, CloudTrail contains kms:Decrypt by forwarder role, re-run delivery for missing window, generate signed proof bundle.
Priya K.: I'll draft a short runbook and alert config for Auburn: delivery delta alert, replay steps, and checklist for audit playback.
Maddie H.: Owners: Kyra (INFRA-4821), Josh (KMS verification), Samir (proof bundle), Priya (runbook & comms). Check-in in 3h. :thumbsup:
